violations.why: ISR sets v_onyx=50 between the loop init write and the loop condition read, so the task sees a value it did not write.
ISR overwrites v_onyx after the init write, so the index used at line 22 is not the one the task wrote.
The condition check and the array index use different values if the ISR writes v_onyx between them.
The ISR write is lost or skewed by the non-atomic v_onyx++ read-modify-write.
ISR changes v_onyx between the index read and the increment read, so the increment starts from a different value.
The ISR overwrites the incremented value before the loop condition reads it.
